entities.summary: Itaúna is a Brazilian municipality in the state of Minas Gerais. It is located in the Iron Quadrangle, within the Metropolitan Belt, 80 km from Belo Horizonte in the Central-West region of Minas. It borders Itatiaiuçu to the south, Mateus Leme to the east, Carmo do Cajuru to the west, Pará de Minas to the north, and Igaratinga to the northwest. Its estimated population in 2024 is 102,500 inhabitants.
